title: Benchmark rust-ipfs as IPFS client in a minimal Rust harness
description:
Same benchmark harness as the iroh spike but using rust-ipfs. Add a 1 KB block, retrieve by CID, pin. 10,000 iterations. Record p50/p99/p999 latency and RSS. Artifact: benchmark binary and results markdown.

Acceptance:
- rust-ipfs dependency compiles on stable Rust edition 2021
- Benchmark runs headlessly with cargo bench
- Results file with same metrics as iroh benchmark for direct comparison
- IPFS daemon requirement (if any) documented
